hypothesis_summary: 도훈 B-path mandate Session 81 (L-316 mandate inherit). KRX 외국인/기관/개인 net buying disclosure 기반 sophistication alpha. STR_1715 H1 (가격+재무+컨센서스 7-factor 기반) vs 본 cycle (disclosure flow 기반) information source 본질 다름. 5-factor ex-ante grid strict (V6 N=37 post-hoc DSR FAIL learning inherit). 단, L-316 mandate에 따라 alpha-vector level + portfolio realized level 양 단계 직교성 의무 검증 결과: alpha-vector level PASS (|cor|<0.073 max), **portfolio realized level FAIL (Pearson 0.7376 >> 0.40 threshold)**. KR equity-only single asset class beta 0.8+ 공유 본질 한계 L-316 inheritance 100% reproduce. **Selected**: F4_Smart_Money_Concentration_Decoupled (INV10 × INV11) **contrarian direction** (Boehmer-Wu 2013 + Da-Engelberg-Gao 2011 + Choe-Kho-Stulz 2005 + KR retail-overreaction empirical). |ICIR|=0.322, Harvey_t=-4.47, SubStab=0.657 — 모두 PASS. **Monotonicity=0.556 < 0.70 도훈 hard mandate FAIL**. Decile pattern: D1 +1.17%/m → D10 +0.046%/m clear monotonic contrarian. **Selection status**: NON_GRADUATING_MONO_FAIL_AND_PORTFOLIO_REALIZED_COR_FAIL — graduation gates 5/6 hard mandate criteria 미충족. F4 = z(INV10 smart money share, [-1,1] within transactions) × z(INV11 foreign top-decile indicator) — concentrated smart money signal direction empirically validated as CONTRARIAN in KR for sub-K200/KQ150 1M horizon.
